description: Machine-readable record of what has actually been observed to work, as of the evidence cited per entry -- not a claim about what should work. status values: verified (real cluster/host, evidence cited), build-verified (compiles and passes stubbed-runner unit tests only, no real filesystem/cluster exercised), unverified (implemented, never exercised), known-gap (a specific, named blocker exists).

filesystemBackends.evidence: Air-Gap E2E workflow (.github/workflows/e2e-airgap.yaml): real prjquota-mounted XFS loopback host, quota apply/rolling-upgrade/idempotent-resync and NFSv4 wire-path write rejection verified in CI (#149).
filesystemBackends.notes: Primary target filesystem for this project; exercised in the Air-Gap E2E workflow matrix.

filesystemBackends.evidence: Air-Gap E2E workflow (.github/workflows/e2e-airgap.yaml), ext4 matrix job: real prjquota-mounted ext4 loopback host on a GitHub-hosted runner, Stages A-E green -- main workflow_dispatch run 41930165167 (2026-11-05) and PR #218 run 41920665132 (ubuntu24/20261101.360, kernel 7.0.0-1017-azure); Stage D's non-root 120 MiB write fails with EDQUOT at the 100 MB limit (#217).
filesystemBackends.notes: Enforcement caveat, not a code defect: ext4 project quota hard limits are not enforced for a CAP_SYS_RESOURCE (root) writer -- fs/quota/dquot.c ignore_hardlimit() -- so over an export with no_root_squash a root-owned pod bypasses the limit (Stage D documents this with a supplementary root-writer step; see AGENTS.md). Host prerequisite: quota_tree/quota_v2 kernel modules, shipped in linux-modules-extra up to 6.17-azure and in base linux-modules on linux-azure-7.0 (#217). History: PR #155's first ext4 run (33892085732) fixed a repquota -P name-keyed row parsing bug in internal/quota/report.go.

filesystemBackends.evidence: Air-Gap E2E workflow (.github/workflows/e2e-airgap.yaml), btrfs matrix job: real btrfs loopback filesystem with `btrfs quota enable` and a subvolume per PV on a GitHub-hosted runner, Stages A-E green -- main workflow_dispatch run 41930165167 (2026-11-05) and PR #218 run 41920665132; quota limit enforced for both non-root and root writers.
filesystemBackends.notes: The target path must already be a subvolume with `btrfs quota enable` configured by the host/operator. The earlier missing-btrfs-progs container defect was repaired in PR #86.

architectures.evidence: Air-Gap E2E workflow runs the agent in a Kind cluster on GitHub-hosted runners with real xfs/ext4/btrfs quota enforcement -- main workflow_dispatch run 41930165167 (2026-11-05), whose job log records the build host as GOHOSTARCH='amd64', the agent binary built with GOARCH=amd64 and the loaded image config "architecture": "amd64"; release.yaml also cross-compiles and multi-arch builds this target.
nfs-quota-agent#4 E2E session ran on Apple Silicon (arm64) via colima -- full agent deploy, quota enforcement, rolling upgrade all observed on this architecture.
release.yaml cross-compiles and multi-arch buildx-builds this target on every tagged release; no functional E2E has been run on this architecture.

kubernetesVersions.evidence: nfs-quota-agent#4 E2E session (prior to the 1.36 pass documented in the same issue): DaemonSet/PDB/RBAC/CRD/CEL admission all exercised.
nfs-quota-agent#4 E2E session: same coverage as 1.35, plus the DaemonSet+PDB scale-subresource limitation documented there (issues/4 comment).

knownLimitations.summary: PodDisruptionBudget against a DaemonSet-managed pod fails closed (blocks all Eviction API disruption) on k3s v1.36.3 due to a k8s core limitation ("daemonsets.apps does not implement the scale subresource"). helm-upgrade-driven rolling replacement is unaffected -- it does not go through the Eviction API.
